en.headline: sogeisetsu opens three openchamber issues on multi-run UI/docs/test gaps
en.summary: On 2026-10-03, sogeisetsu made 3 commits to their own repository sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu and opened three issues on openchamber/openchamber, all related to the multi-run feature after commit d9fbf6b removed the sidebar header button. The first issue, #4337, reported that multi-run documentation still references the removed sidebar header button, which has moved to the composer. The second issue, #4345, noted that the command palette's "Parallel run" entry shares the checkbox-multiple icon with the sidebar's "Select sessions" toggle, causing visual confusion. The third issue, #4346, pointed out that SidebarHeader.test.tsx still passes despite onOpenMultiRun and canOpenMultiRun having been removed. openchamber-bot replied to both #4337 and #4345 within minutes, tagging each as fix-ready with traced root causes. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 在 openchamber 提交三个关于 multi-run 的 UI/文档/测试问题
zh.summary: 2026-10-03，sogeisetsu 在自己的仓库 sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu 提交了 3 次 commit，并在 openchamber/openchamber 上开了三个 issue，均与 commit d9fbf6b 移除侧边栏头部按钮后的 multi-run 功能相关。第一个 issue #4337 指出 multi-run 文档仍引用已移除的侧边栏头部按钮，该按钮已移至 composer。第二个 issue #4345 指出命令面板的"Parallel run"条目与侧边栏"Select sessions"切换共用 checkbox-multiple 图标，造成视觉混淆。第三个 issue #4346 指出 SidebarHeader.test.tsx 在 onOpenMultiRun 和 canOpenMultiRun 被移除后仍然通过。openchamber-bot 在数分钟内分别回复了 #4337 和 #4345，将两者标记为 fix-ready 并追溯了根因。当天无 PR、review 或 release 记录。
